roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, providing an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on both staff competency and patient safety.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of our residents and staff through robust surveillance, policy enforcement, and continuous training.If you are a passionate Registered Nurse with a commitment to excellence in both staff development and infection control, and thrive in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
requirements: Experience in staff development or adult education
Experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential opportunity within a recently acquired facility, offering significant potential for growth and impact. We are looking for a professional who is eager to contribute to a thriving environment and drive successful marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be presentable, highly driven, and possess a strong ability to achieve results. This role requires flexibility, including the ability to work occasional weekends to meet business needs. We are prepared to offer excellent compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate a proven track record of success.
requirements: Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Proven track record in marketing, preferably within healthcare or skilled nursing
Experience in strategic marketing and community outreach

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a flexible schedule and the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting your expertise and commitment. We also offer a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome you to our team. If you are a compassionate and skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and unrestricted Florida SLP license
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
